articles.content: Jasprit Bumrah exhibited a different run-up style during the second Test match against New Zealand in Christchurch. While he did not take any wickets on the opening day, other Indian bowlers made significant contributions. Akash Deep was particularly effective, taking two crucial wickets to help India gain momentum. New Zealand ended the first day at 246 for 5, mainly due to Tom Blundell's notable performance.
